name: Speciesbathymetry Pattern
description: to represent species together with their typical environment in terms of bathymetric range and water area
scenarios: give me the species found below 200 metres for water area '24'
competency_questions: what species have what (typical) bathymetric range in what water area? where can species be typical found for a certain water area?
